players.name: Shamz
players.funFact: Christopher Samba at 8pm. Brian Brobbey by 9:45. Same man, different era.

players.name: Mo Bouch
players.funFact: Calm, clean, always on the front foot. Just needs to bring the bite back. Currently a golden retriever.

players.name: Ahmed PB
players.funFact: Vice captain and one third of the FHG (Fence Hogger Group). If a crime is ever committed, forensics only need to visit one fence.

players.name: Westway
players.funFact: His birth certificate says Pitch 5. The originals know he was earthed on Pitch 2. Part-time keeper who couldn't save a shot from a pensioner.

players.name: Ruislip
players.funFact: A Duracell battery on its last legs. Quick off the buzzer, flat by 9:15.

players.name: Ragz
players.funFact: When he's having a stinker, the Carragher quote echoes round the pitch. One week a 7 or 8 out of 10, the next a 4 or 5. Nobody knows which Ragz is turning up.

players.name: Sudz
players.funFact: Born in Bangalore, Sudanese by choice, living in Middlesbrough. Loves touching lights, as seen during Diwali. On the pitch, a difference maker for better or worse.

players.name: Skinz
players.funFact: Mr Waistcoat. Winter is not his season, so keep the paramedics close. Ten minutes before kick-off: Red Bull, Swiss burrito and a cheeseburger. Mandatory.

players.name: Yusuf TT
players.funFact: Captain, chairman and founder of FHG. His use of the fence deserves a PhD. Loves a goal from behind the halfway line. Border Force just rings Phoenix to check it's him crossing via the fence.

players.name: AF
players.funFact: KDB's "let me talk" energy, but who's listening? Needs to focus on football and cool down. The hair's already gone and the eyebrows could follow.

players.name: Hanad Grove
players.birthplace: In between Hayes & Grove, West London
players.funFact: Where do we begin? 30 goals in Div 12 of the Sunday Barnet League, then keeper, then CB, then midfielder. A car with no brakes on the ball. Sudz might recruit him soon.

players.name: Hanad Southall
players.funFact: Strong, energetic and versatile — another academy graduate. When he isn’t writing SQL, he’s breaking up play in midfield.

players.name: Yahya
players.funFact: Fast, versatile and reliable. AF called him up from the academy this season and he hasn’t left the starting XI since. Don’t forget his gift.

players.name: Luqman
players.funFact: Mr Dark Arts, until it's done to him. Skates on thin ice and prime suspect in Nappy Gate.

players.name: Ayoub
players.funFact: Goes with the flow of the game. Toxic one minute, not the next. The PIP days are long gone: a fully charged battery whenever he's on the pitch.

players.name: Dualeh
players.birthplace: Just The Behind Striker, West London
players.funFact: Find him between the lines — nutmegs are his love language.

players.name: Ali Awil
players.funFact: Place of birth: Too Good To Go. Current residence: EatClub HQ.
